output.summary: A flowering tree found along tropical coasts and rivers across parts of the Old and New Worlds. It has spiny bark, light orange flowers and buoyant seeds that can disperse across oceans. Its buds and leaves are eaten as vegetables, including leaves in Thai miang kham, although its alkaloids are poisonous in larger amounts.
output.edibilityNote: Buds and leaves are eaten as vegetables; in Thailand, leaves are often used in miang kham.
